## Problem and behavior

Describe the concrete problem, the cleanup scope before/after, and source evidence for each new deletion path.

## Validation

- [ ] `bash scripts/check.sh` passes.
- [ ] Destructive tests use temporary fixtures only.
- [ ] Symlinks, protected data and failure reporting were checked.
- [ ] No credentials, user reports or private paths are included.

## Maintainer / authorized AI review

Record the reviewer, reviewed commit, findings and disposition before merging. External contributions require maintainer or authorized AI review. A checklist alone is not approval.
